signs.aries: You make friends quickly and fall out with them just as fast, and you are the one who gets a group moving.
signs.taurus: You keep the same few friends for decades, are slow to let anyone new in, and are the steady one in every group.
signs.gemini: You know a great many people lightly, your friendships run on conversation, and you are the connector between separate circles.
signs.cancer: Your friends become family, you look after the group, and you are hurt more than you say when you are left out of something.
signs.leo: You are warm and generous with your friends and want to be central to the group, and your circle tends to form around you.
signs.virgo: You are the useful one in every group, help practically rather than emotionally, and are quietly selective about who counts as a friend.
signs.libra: Your friendships are important and carefully balanced, you dislike group conflict, and you are the one who keeps everyone speaking.
signs.scorpio: You have few friends and they are deep ones, you test people before trusting them, and a betrayal ends a friendship for good.
signs.sagittarius: Your friends are scattered across places and outlooks, you pick them up easily, and you need a group that leaves you free.
signs.capricorn: You take friendship seriously and make it slowly, tend to end up organising the group, and your circle is small and long-standing.
signs.aquarius: This is your home ground: you belong to causes and communities, and your friends are the ones who are also slightly outside things.
signs.pisces: You absorb the mood of any group you join, are drawn to gentle or lost people, and your hopes for the future are unspecific but strong.
